summary: Decorah Community School District urges the FCC to preserve E‑Rate support, maintain connectivity and safety requirements, keep Category One and Two funding, promote transparent bidding, and retain rural discounts while simplifying procedures. The comment urges the FCC to preserve the E‑Rate program, citing financial hardship for rural schools.
